notes: Scorer round5/tests/score_holdout.py (existing/holdout_notes/runs/round8/holdout_round8.json). Pair level, Y named, precedent family; each (X, Y) read on the date of its first holdout statement. recall = negOrPartly (X negative or partly negative by any actor on that date); recall_strict = whole-decision negative by Y; precision = reverse direction (of the model's whole-decision negative (X, actor) rows whose X a holdout note of this family names with a Y, the share where the note names the model's actor). pool_* = the frozen testable pool (9,374 pairs not explicitly admitted by round 4; alsoInFeed / holdoutOnly halves); 71%% of the pool is 'overruled on other grounds' notes where partly is the right answer. Blind in input: holdout speakers never feed the model (check_no_leak.py); round-5 builders did see these aggregate scores at each iteration (TESTS.md, results/holdout_it*).
